phases.title: Cloud Concepts
phases.subtitle: Understand the foundations of cloud computing and the cloud service models.
phases.description: Start with the fundamentals: what cloud computing means, why organizations use it, and how cloud services are delivered.

episodes.title: Course Overview
episodes.description: Understand the learning path and exam preparation approach.

episodes.title: Cloud Computing, High Availability, Scalability, Elasticity, Agility, Fault Tolerance, and Disaster Recovery
episodes.description: Core cloud concepts and the benefits of cloud computing.

episodes.title: Principles of Economies of Scale
episodes.description: How shared infrastructure and large-scale operations can reduce costs.

episodes.title: Capital Expenditure (CapEx) vs Operational Expenditure (OpEx)
episodes.description: Compare upfront infrastructure spending with ongoing operating costs.

episodes.title: Consumption-based Model
episodes.description: Understand paying for the resources and services you use.

episodes.title: IaaS, PaaS, SaaS and their differences
episodes.description: Compare the three main cloud service models and their responsibilities.

episodes.title: Public, Private, Hybrid cloud and their differences
episodes.description: Choose a cloud deployment model based on ownership and access.

phases.title: Azure Architecture & Services
phases.subtitle: Explore Azure's global infrastructure and core services.
phases.description: Learn how Azure is organized and identify the compute, networking, storage, data, and platform services available.

episodes.title: Azure Regions and Availability Zones
episodes.description: Azure's global datacenter geography and resiliency options.

episodes.title: Azure Resource Groups and Resource Manager
episodes.description: Organize, deploy, and manage Azure resources.

episodes.title: Azure Compute Services | Virtual Machine, VM Scale Set, App Service, Functions, Container Instances, Kubernetes Service
episodes.description: Choose the right Azure compute service for an application or workload.

episodes.title: Azure Networking Services | Virtual Network, Load Balancer, VPN Gateway, Application Gateway, CDN
episodes.description: Connect resources and distribute or secure network traffic.

episodes.title: Azure Storage Services | Blob, Disk, File and Archive
episodes.description: Understand Azure's common storage services and their uses.

episodes.title: Database Services | Cosmos DB, SQL Database, SQL DB for MySQL and PostgreSQL, SQL Managed Instance
episodes.description: Select an Azure database service for different data workloads.

episodes.title: Azure Marketplace
episodes.description: Discover and deploy solutions and services from Microsoft and partners.

episodes.title: Azure IoT Services | IoT Hub, IoT Central, Azure Sphere
episodes.description: Connect, manage, and secure Internet of Things devices.

episodes.title: Azure Big Data and Analytics Services | Synapse Analytics, HDInsight, Databricks
episodes.description: Explore services for analytics and large-scale data processing.

episodes.title: Azure Artificial Intelligence (AI) Services | Machine Learning Studio and Service
episodes.description: Discover Azure AI and machine learning capabilities.

episodes.title: Azure Serverless Computing Services | Functions, Logic Apps, Event Grid
episodes.description: Build event-driven solutions without managing servers.

episodes.title: Azure DevOps Solutions | Azure DevOps, DevTest Labs
episodes.description: Understand development, delivery, and testing services.

phases.title: Azure Management, Security & Governance
phases.subtitle: Learn how organizations operate, protect, and govern Azure resources.
phases.description: Practice management tools, network security, identity, access control, policy, and compliance concepts.

episodes.title: Azure Tools | Portal, PowerShell, CLI and Cloud Shell
episodes.description: Manage Azure resources using graphical and command-line tools.

episodes.title: Azure Advisor
episodes.description: Review recommendations for reliability, security, performance, cost, and operational excellence.

episodes.title: Security Groups | NSG and ASG | Network Security Groups and Application Security Groups
episodes.description: Control network traffic and group virtual machine workloads.

episodes.title: User-defined Routes (UDR)
episodes.description: Control how network traffic is routed in an Azure virtual network.

episodes.title: Azure Firewall
episodes.description: Understand managed network firewall protection.

episodes.title: Azure DDoS Protection
episodes.description: Protect applications and resources from distributed denial-of-service attacks.

episodes.title: Azure Identity Services | Identity, Authentication, Authorization & Azure AD
episodes.description: Understand identities and the difference between authentication and authorization.

episodes.title: Azure Security Center and usage scenarios
episodes.description: Improve security posture and protect cloud workloads.

episodes.title: Key Vault
episodes.description: Securely store and manage secrets, keys, and certificates.

episodes.title: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
episodes.description: Assign permissions to users, groups, and applications at a scope.

episodes.title: Resource Locks
episodes.description: Protect important resources from accidental deletion or modification.

episodes.title: Tags
episodes.description: Add metadata to resources for organization, reporting, and cost allocation.

episodes.title: Azure Policy
episodes.description: Audit and enforce organizational standards across resources.

episodes.title: Azure Blueprints
episodes.description: Understand the former blueprint service and its governance concepts.

episodes.title: Cloud Adoption Framework
episodes.description: Use Microsoft's guidance to plan and manage cloud adoption.

episodes.title: Core tenets of Security, Privacy, and Compliance
episodes.description: Review shared security, privacy, and compliance fundamentals.

phases.title: Cost Management & Reliability
phases.subtitle: Prepare for pricing, optimization, SLAs, and service lifecycle questions.
phases.description: Understand the factors that affect Azure costs, how to plan and control spending, and how reliability is described.

episodes.title: Cost Affecting Factors
episodes.description: Identify the factors that influence the cost of Azure resources.

episodes.title: Cost Reduction Methods and Pricing, TCO Calculators
episodes.description: Explore pricing tools and estimate cloud costs and total cost of ownership.

episodes.title: Azure Cost Management
episodes.description: Monitor, analyze, budget, and optimize Azure spending.

episodes.title: Azure Service Level Agreement (SLA)
episodes.description: Understand service availability commitments and composite SLAs.

episodes.title: Service lifecycle in Azure
episodes.description: Understand preview and generally available service stages.
